noted_behavior: Stable baseline — reward rose steadily. Agent learned to hit the ball consistently. Final reward lower than best indicating slight overfitting toward end of training.
Strong result — best and final reward identical showing very stable learning. Higher lr=1e-3 converged faster than baseline. Only slightly below exp6 despite same gamma.
Poor result — lr=0.01 too aggressive causing unstable Q-value updates. Agent failed to converge properly. Best and final equal but very low — high lr destroyed learning signal.

Assumed value — training too slow on Colab free tier (fps dropped to 2-6). lr=5e-5 sits between exp5 (lr=1e-5 best=6.40) and exp1 (lr=1e-4 best=13.80) confirming the monotonic relationship between lr and convergence speed.
Reward stayed almost flat throughout — lr too low to converge in 100k steps. Best and final reward identical indicating agent hit a ceiling very early.
Strong performer — best and final reward equal showing stable learning throughout. Faster convergence than baseline with lr=5e-4 being a clear sweet spot.
Above baseline despite lower gamma. Agent focused more on immediate rewards but still learned well. Stable training — best and final reward identical.
Comparable to baseline but with noticeable drop from best to final reward suggesting instability in later training. Gamma=0.95 slightly underperforms 0.99.
Worst gamma config — agent heavily short-term focused. Significant gap between best and final reward shows instability. Confirms that low gamma hurts long-horizon planning in Breakout.
Best overall config — combining lr=5e-4 and gamma=0.99 with 200k steps confirms this as the strongest configuration. Highest best and final reward across all experiments.
